function: p. 1: Learned joint pilot design, CSI estimation, DJSCC feedback and multiuser precoding design, trained end-to-end to maximize downlink spectral efficiency.
system: p. 8: FDD MU-MIMO OFDM; BS 32 logical ports (8x8 dual-polarized), single-antenna users, up to 6; 1.9 GHz downlink, 2.1 GHz uplink, 10 MHz; no RIS.
method: p. 6-8: Complex FC and CNN encoder at UE, CNN plus masked multi-head-attention Transformer precoder at BS, DJSCC; end-to-end unsupervised training on spectral-efficiency loss (Adam, 500 epochs).
data_channel: p. 8: QuaDRiGa 3GPP_38.901_UMa channels (17 clusters), 100,000 training, 30,000 validation, 10,000 test samples; UMi set also from QuaDRiGa (p. 14); no measurements.
test_conditions: p. 14-15: Main results train and test on UMa; scenario shift trains on UMa or UMi, tests on both (Table IV); SNRce training-testing mismatch (Fig. 16).
baselines: p. 9-12: Classical SVD and MMSE precoding with water-filling, DFT pilot; learned JFPNet (earlier method [17], ideal CE), SEFPNet (separate CE), JEFPNet with DNN user-adaptive precoder of [23].
metrics: p. 10-13: Downlink spectral efficiency (bps/Hz); number of parameters and FLOPs (p. 13); storage overhead.
complexity: p. 11, 13: 258,300 learnable parameters at BS; UE side only 2.63% of the parameters and 0.019% of the FLOPs of the separate architecture (Fig. 13).
q1_support: p. 8: "scenario configurations follow the 3rd Generation Partnership Project (3GPP) TR 38.901 standard"; p. 14: "The UMi dataset is also generated using QuaDriGa following 3GPP TR 38.901 and TR 38.873"
q2_support: p. 14: "We train JEFPNet under both UMa and UMi scenarios and subsequently test the trained models in both environments"
q3_support: p. 10: "JEFPNet delivers performance gains of 1.42 bps/Hz over SVD and 0.96 bps/Hz over MMSE"; p. 9: "we use the network architecture ideas as [17] to jointly design the CSI feedback and precoding design networks"
q4_support: p. 13: "the proposed JEFPNet architecture requires only 2.63% of the parameters and 0.019% of the FLOPs compared to the separate architectures"
q5_support: p. 8: "The dataset comprises 100,000 training samples, 30,000 validation samples, and 10,000 test samples". The data are generated by the authors with QuaDRiGa; no link to code or data appears anywhere in the paper.
notes: Title and DOI checked on p. 1 (Joint CSI Estimation-Feedback-Precoding via DJSCC for MU-MIMO OFDM Systems). Area 3 chosen because the main metric is downlink spectral efficiency (precoding); area 2 is the alternative since estimation and feedback are part of the joint design. SVD and MMSE baselines take CSI from learned CE and feedback modules, but their precoder is classical. JFPNet [17] is shown with ideal CE (p. 10) and SEFPNet and JEFPNet (DNN) reuse earlier modules [29], [23], so q3 is the item for the reviewer to confirm. QuaDRiGa is a channel generator, not a released dataset, so q5 is 0.
